sources.title: Ministry of Corporate Affairs: MCA21 services (SPICe+, annual filings)

conditions.label: GST registered, monthly returns
conditions.description: Files GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B every month.

conditions.label: GST registered, QRMP scheme
conditions.description: Files quarterly returns and pays monthly under the QRMP scheme.

conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Deducts tax at source from salaries.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The name in the certificate of incorporation, ending in "Private Limited".

profileFields.label: TAN
profileFields.description: Tax deduction account number, for TDS.

profileFields.label: GSTIN
profileFields.description: The GST identification number, per state.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Each director has a DIN; a private company needs at least two.

setupSteps.title: Apply for the name and incorporation (SPICe+)
setupSteps.description: File SPICe+ on the MCA portal with the memorandum and articles; it also gives the PAN and TAN.

setupSteps.title: Set the financial year end to 31 March
setupSteps.description: Indian companies and LLPs keep an April to March financial year. Set the financial year end in Profile to 03-31 so the dates below are right.

setupSteps.title: Open the company bank account
setupSteps.description: Needed for the subscription money from the shareholders.

setupSteps.title: Declare commencement of business
setupSteps.description: File the declaration that the subscribers have paid for their shares. Check the deadline on the MCA portal.

setupSteps.title: Appoint the first auditor
setupSteps.description: Check the deadline with the MCA portal or a company secretary.

setupSteps.title: Register for GST if needed
setupSteps.description: Register on the GST portal when the turnover or the type of supply requires it.

obligations.title: Annual general meeting
obligations.description: Held after each financial year to adopt the accounts. Check the time limit for your company.

obligations.title: File the financial statements (AOC-4)
obligations.description: Within 30 days of the annual general meeting that adopted them (section 137). The date shown counts from an AGM on the last allowed day.

obligations.title: Annual return (MGT-7 or MGT-7A)
obligations.description: Filed after the annual general meeting. Check the time limit on the MCA portal.

obligations.title: Income tax return (ITR-6)
obligations.description: Companies have their accounts audited; the return is due on 31 October for a March year end (the tax audit report a month before). Check each year for extensions.

obligations.title: Directors' KYC
obligations.description: Each director with a DIN updates their KYC every year. Check the date on the MCA portal.

obligations.title: GSTR-1, monthly
obligations.description: Outward supplies for the month, by the 11th of the next month.

obligations.title: GSTR-3B, monthly
obligations.description: Summary return and tax payment by the 20th of the next month (the government can extend it).

obligations.title: GSTR-1, quarterly (QRMP)
obligations.description: Due after each quarter; the portal shows the current date. The date shown is the last day of the month after the quarter, as the FAQ states.

obligations.title: GSTR-3B, quarterly (QRMP)
obligations.description: Due on the 22nd or 24th of the month after the quarter, depending on the state; tax is paid monthly. The date shown is the 22nd.

obligations.title: TDS deposits and quarterly statements
obligations.description: Tax deducted at source is deposited monthly and reported quarterly. Check the dates with the Income Tax Department.
